name: Futako-Tamagawa
tagline: Shibuya in 19 minutes and Shinjuku in 29 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 19 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 13.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 13.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 7.8 m to 19 m, a difference of 11.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 5 to 10 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 9 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 日産厚生会 玉川病院, about 17 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is グランダ岡本里安邸, about 19 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line run through it. Tokyu Oimachi Line also call here. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池尻大橋→渋谷; trains from here toward 渋谷 pass through it. Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118%. Trains from here toward 自由が丘 also pass through its busiest stretch, 九品仏→自由が丘. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Kaminoge; for how close the centre is, Futako-Tamagawa.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Futako-Tamagawa in a straight line. Both have the Tokyu Oimachi Line. Futako-Tamagawa also has the Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line, which Kaminoge does not. Futako-Tamagawa is at least 7 minutes quicker to Shinjuku and Shibuya. On what it offers families, though, Kaminoge comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Yoga; for lower rent, Futako-Tamagawa.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Futako-Tamagawa in a straight line. Both have the Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line. Futako-Tamagawa also has the Tokyu Oimachi Line, which Yoga does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥6,000 more at Yoga. On what it offers families, Yoga comes out ahead.
